en: Sepia-toned photograph of an oriental-style street scene, likely a bazaar. A tall, slender wooden tower or minaret-like structure rises from the corner of a two‑storey building with arched windows and a projecting balcony above an archway. Market stalls with awnings line the street, and several people in early 20th‑century dress walk or sit in the foreground. The image has a cream border typical of old postcards, and at the bottom there is a small printed website credit.
